examples.description: Check whether the supplier profile is set up

preconditions: At most one row per tenant — an empty list means the profile is not set up yet.

description: List the supplier profile: at most one row per tenant. An empty list means setup is not done, and myinvois_invoice_generate refuses until it is: call myinvois_settings_save with the company, TIN, BRN, MSIC code and address. NEXT: myinvois_invoice_generate.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor — pass a previous response's next_cursor verbatim. null next_cursor means no further pages.

limit.description: Page size 1-200. Omit BOTH limit and cursor for the legacy bare-array first page of 200; pass either to get { items, next_cursor, limit } instead.

name: myinvois_settings_list
